name: Expert_ABC_WS_CCI
summary: This EA uses a CCI (Commodity Channel Index) indicator smoothed by a Moving Average as its core signal filter within the MQL5 Standard Library Expert Advisor framework. It opens and closes positions based on threshold-based signal logic, employs no trailing stop, and uses fixed lot money management. The strategy relies on CCI momentum shifts confirmed by MA smoothing to generate trade signals.
summary_zh: 该EA使用CCI（商品通道指标）配合移动平均线平滑作为核心信号过滤器，基于MQL5标准库专家顾问框架构建。它根据阈值信号逻辑开仓和平仓，不使用追踪止损，采用固定手数资金管理。策略依赖CCI动量变化并经MA平滑确认后产生交易信号。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是基于CCI动量指标结合MA平滑滤波来捕捉市场动量变化方向。入场条件由CCI周期（默认37）计算动量值，再通过MA周期（默认13）进行平滑处理，当综合信号强度超过开仓阈值（默认40）时触发入场。出场条件为信号强度低于平仓阈值（默认20）时平仓，同时支持止盈止损设置但默认值为0即未启用。仓位管理采用固定手数模式（默认0.1手），不根据账户余额动态调整。资金管理使用CMoneyFixedLot类，以固定百分比（默认10%）和固定手数进行配置，没有动态风险调整机制。整体策略属于标准库框架下的动量跟踪型系统，逻辑清晰但缺乏自适应和动态风控能力。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on combining the CCI momentum indicator with MA smoothing to capture directional momentum shifts in the market. Entry conditions are triggered when the CCI (period 37 by default) generates a momentum value that is smoothed by a Moving Average (period 13 by default), and the composite signal strength exceeds the opening threshold (default 40 on a 0-100 scale). Exit conditions occur when the signal strength falls below the closing threshold (default 20), with optional stop loss and take profit levels that default to zero (disabled). Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach (default 0.1 lots) without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or volatility. Money management relies on the CMoneyFixedLot class configured with a fixed percentage (default 10%) and fixed lot size, lacking any dynamic risk scaling mechanism. The overall strategy is a momentum-following system within the MQL5 Standard Library framework, with clear logic but limited adaptability and no dynamic risk controls.

parameters.name: Signal_ThresholdOpen
parameters.description: 开仓信号阈值[0...100]，信号强度超过此值时开仓
parameters.description_en: Open signal threshold [0...100]; opens when exceeded

parameters.name: Signal_ThresholdClose
parameters.description: 平仓信号阈值[0...100]，信号强度低于此值时平仓
parameters.description_en: Close signal threshold [0...100]; closes when below

parameters.name: Signal_PriceLevel
parameters.description: 执行交易的价格水平，0为市价执行
parameters.description_en: Trade execution price level; 0 = market price

parameters.name: Signal_StopLevel
parameters.description: 止损水平（点数），0表示未设置止损

parameters.name: Signal_TakeLevel
parameters.description: 止盈水平（点数），0表示未设置止盈

pros: 基于MQL5标准库框架构建，代码结构规范清晰，易于维护和扩展
使用CCI+MA双重过滤机制，平滑了CCI的噪音信号，减少虚假信号触发
信号阈值开仓/平仓分离设计，提供了灵活的进出场控制机制
采用标准库的模块化设计，信号、追踪、资金管理各模块解耦，便于替换优化
pros_en: Built on the MQL5 Standard Library framework with clean, well-structured code that is easy to maintain and extend
CCI + MA dual filtering mechanism smooths out CCI noise and reduces false signal triggers
Separate threshold values for opening and closing positions provide flexible entry/exit control
Modular design with decoupled signal, trailing, and money management components makes it easy to swap or upgrade individual modules
cons: 止损和止盈默认值均为0，存在无限亏损风险，缺乏基本的风险保护
固定手数资金管理不考虑账户规模和波动性，无法动态调整风险敞口
未使用追踪止损（CTrailingNone），无法锁定浮动利润，盈利交易可能大幅回撤
缺乏新K线柱检查机制（Expert_EveryTick=false但非严格的新柱检测），可能在同一根K线上重复信号处理
CCI参数周期37和MA周期13未经充分优化验证，可能不适配所有市场环境
cons_en: Stop loss and take profit default to zero, creating unlimited loss risk with no basic risk protection
Fixed lot money management ignores account size and volatility, unable to dynamically adjust risk exposure
No trailing stop used (CTrailingNone), so floating profits cannot be locked in and winning trades may experience significant drawdowns
Lacks a strict new bar check mechanism (Expert_EveryTick=false is not the same as proper new bar detection), potentially processing signals repeatedly on the same bar
CCI period 37 and MA period 13 are not thoroughly optimized or validated, may not suit all market conditions
improvements: 添加非零的默认止损止盈参数，并实现基于ATR的动态止损机制以适应市场波动性
引入追踪止损模块替代CTrailingNone，以在趋势延续时锁定利润并降低回撤风险
增加新K线柱严格检测和点差过滤，避免在不利条件下重复开仓和高成本交易
improvements_en: Add non-zero default stop loss and take profit parameters, and implement ATR-based dynamic stop loss to adapt to market volatility
Replace CTrailingNone with a trailing stop module to lock in profits during trend continuation and reduce drawdown risk
Add strict new bar detection and spread filtering to avoid repeated position opening and high-cost trading under unfavorable conditions

risk_points: 止损和止盈均默认为0，没有任何价格保护机制，单笔交易可能面临无限亏损
固定手数不随账户余额调整，在连续亏损时风险比例会不断增大
缺乏追踪止损导致已盈利交易可能完全回撤至亏损
risk_points_en: Stop loss and take profit both default to zero with no price protection, exposing each trade to unlimited loss potential
Fixed lot sizing does not adjust with account balance, causing risk ratio to increase during consecutive losses
Absence of trailing stop means profitable trades can fully retrace into loss territory
